function.name: autocomplete_for_waze
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "waze", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Waze/Google autocomplete/type-ahead for places, locations and addresses."

lang.description: The language of the results. See https://wazeopedia.waze.com/wiki/USA/Countries_and_Languages for a list of supported languages.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) bias. Highly recommended to use for getting accurate results.

function.name: driving_directions_for_waze
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "waze", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get routes and driving directions from Waze/Google."

source_coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude pair) of the starting point

destination_coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude pair) of the destination

return_route_coordinates.description: Whether to return route coordinate pairs (`route_coordinates` field)

arrival_timestamp.description: Unix-timestamp (seconds since epoch) of the arrival time (in case not specified directions will be returned for current time)

function.name: alerts_and_jams_for_waze
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "waze", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get real-time alerts and jams from Waze in a geographic rectangular area defined by bottom-left and top-right latitude, longitude pairs."

top_right.description: Top-right corner of the geographic rectangular area for which to get alerts and traffic jams. Specified as latitude, longitude pair.

bottom_left.description: Bottom-left corner of the geographic rectangular area for which to get alerts and traffic jams. Specified as latitude, longitude pair.

max_alerts.description:
Maximum number of alerts to fetch (to avoid fetching alerts set it to `0`).
Default: `20`

max_jams.description:
Maximum number of traffic jams to fetch (to avoid fetching traffic jams, set it to `0`).
Default: `20`
